name: Introduction to Structural Biology
description: Introduction to 3D structures of biomolecules; protein production for crystallography, cryoelectron microscopy and NMR; protein engineering methods for structural biology applications; crystallization of proteins, data collection and phasing; cryoelectron microscopy data collection, 2D to 3D reconstruction; structure refinement; solution structure determination; assignment of electron density; application of hybrid methods; estimating resolution; in situ structural biology using electron tomography; application of structural biology in therapeutics development, structure guided drug discovery.
